entries.title: Honest Shield
entries.answer: Honest Shield is the free-first VPN and malware desk. It links Proton VPN Free, Windscribe Free, and Cloudflare WARP, plus VirusTotal, Malwarebytes Free, and URLhaus. Affiliate notes are on the tab. This build does not sell a VPN and does not hide a paid upsell behind a scare screen.

entries.title: Paste Guard
entries.answer: Paste Guard runs in the browser on the Analyze tab. Verdicts are Safe, Suspicious, or Dangerous. They are heuristics, not an antivirus cloud. On the static site the paste stays on the device. Do not paste seeds or keys into support.

entries.title: Analyze
entries.answer: Analyze is the offline Cisco-style swarm on the Analyze tab. It runs on this device in the static site. The API skeleton can mirror that engine later behind an entitlement, but this page does not upload your paste to chat.

entries.title: Swarm Pass
entries.answer: Swarm Pass stores badges, streaks, and Swarm Credits in this browser (localStorage). Tour completion and the daily Guard check-in earn credits. Install-only and store reviews earn nothing. Credits are not cash, not crypto, and not transferable.

entries.title: Redeem
entries.answer: Redeem is Coming soon. This build does not send XMR, SOL, ETH, or BTC gift cards and does not create a wallet transfer. A future partner path would need Terms and may need KYC. Your credit balance stays local until you opt into sync.

entries.title: Pricing
entries.answer: Plan placeholders, not a charge on this page: a 3-day Pro trial starts on the first anonymous device session and uses Pro limits, then falls back to free. Monthly is $9.99/month. Yearly special is $39.99/year. Free remains after the trial. The live static site does not bill you.

entries.title: Talk to a human
entries.answer: A person can be reached through GitHub Sponsors, which is the sponsor link already on this site: https://github.com/sponsors/StarSwarm-Security. This site does not publish an X or Telegram handle, so support will not invent one.
